WITH filtered_budgets AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    remaining,
    amount - spent as amount_minus_spent
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount >= 75
),
category_stats AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining,
    SUM(amount_minus_spent) as category_total
  FROM filtered_budgets
  GROUP BY category
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(category_total) as overall_avg
  FROM category_stats
)
SELECT
  cs.category,
  cs.avg_remaining,
  cs.category_total as total,
  cs.category_total - oa.overall_avg
FROM category_stats cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE cs.category_total > oa.overall_avg
